rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for giving up or damaging something valuable to achieve another goal.

example.english: To finish the project, we have to sacrifice our weekend rest time.
example.traditional: 為咗完成個計劃，我哋唯有犧牲周末嘅休息時間。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 jyun4 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6 ngo5 dei6 wai4 jau5 hei1 sang1 zau1 mut6 ge3 jau1 sik1 si4 gaan1

rows.meaning: give up for a better goal
rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for giving something up for a more important goal.

example.english: To keep the company afloat, everyone had to make a sacrifice.
example.traditional: 為咗保住間公司，大家都要作出犧牲。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 bou2 zyu6 gaan1 gung1 si1 daai6 gaa1 dou1 jiu3 zok3 ceot1 hei1 sang1

rows.meaning: give up for a better goal
rows.note: Use this when the sacrifice is viewed mainly as the cost paid to achieve something else.

example.english: Winning the championship came at the price of a heavy sacrifice.
example.traditional: 想攞到冠軍，就要付出沉重嘅代價。
example.jyutping: soeng2 lo2 dou3 gun3 gwan1 zau6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 cam4 zung6 ge3 doi6 gaa3

rows.meaning: give up for a better goal
rows.note: Use this for the particular person or thing that is given up or destroyed as the sacrifice.

example.english: In this political struggle, he was merely a sacrifice.
example.traditional: 喺呢場政治鬥爭入面，佢只係一件犧牲品。
example.jyutping: hai2 nei1 coeng4 zing3 zi6 dau3 zang1 jap6 min6 keoi5 zi2 hai6 jat1 gin6 hei1 sang1 ban2
